patrick/The New Mugwumps: On Abundance a.term: The New Mugwumps: On Abundance and Its Limits
patrick/The New Mugwumps: On Abundance a.title: The New Mugwumps: On Abundance and Its Limits

patrick/hanseatic-league-medieval-to-mod.summary: The Hanseatic League as a complete arc case study: a proto-modern trade coalition that rose on medieval-machine infrastructure and collapsed as the modernity machine supplanted the institutional logic that gave it power.
patrick/hanseatic-league-medieval-to-mod.term: The Hanseatic League as Medieval→Modernity Machine Transition
patrick/hanseatic-league-medieval-to-mod.title: The Hanseatic League as Medieval→Modernity Machine Transition

sean/a-geographic-diffusion-axis-for-wor.summary: The World Machines framework tracks which operative logic a moment runs on and how fast its registers change once it's operating, but has no explicit axis for how unevenly a machine spreads geographically once it exists somewhere — a machine can originate in one place and take centuries to actually finish arriving in another.
sean/a-geographic-diffusion-axis-for-wor.term: A geographic-diffusion axis for the World Machines periodization
sean/a-geographic-diffusion-axis-for-wor.title: A geographic-diffusion axis for the World Machines periodization

sean/ai-reoccupies-the-eschatology-slot..summary: Cold War nuclear apocalypse used to be the live, felt version of world-ending dread; that eschatology slot didn't empty out when the Cold War ended, it got a new occupant, and AI existential risk fills the shape of the old chair closely enough to be worth naming as a reoccupation.
sean/ai-reoccupies-the-eschatology-slot..title: AI reoccupies the eschatology slot

sean/appeal-foreclosure.md.summary: Appeal-foreclosure is the proposed test for whether something has become New Nature: not that it is slow or hard to change, but that there is no one to ask. Ossification means a lever exists but is jammed or captured; New Nature means no lever exists at all. Three practical questions apply it: does it change on any schedule you could weigh in on, do people explain it by someone's decision or by how things are, and can you insure against it but not sue over it. Public-key cryptography already passes all three.
sean/appeal-foreclosure.md.title: Appeal-foreclosure

sean/babel-was-a-clue.md.summary: Sean Stevenson reads Leo XIV's 2026 AI encyclical Magnifica Humanitas through the World Machines framework: its organizing metaphor pairs Babel (one language, one direction — the Modernity Machine's pull toward a single future) against Nehemiah's wall rebuilt section by section (plurality that coheres — the Divergence Machine), and the most convergent institution on Earth sides against convergence. The essay treats the metaphor choice, and our surprise at it, as an early signal of a large slow change.
sean/babel-was-a-clue.md.title: Babel Was a Clue

sean/blumenberg-and-eliza.md.summary: Blumenberg's little-known reading of Weizenbaum's ELIZA argues that intelligence, human included, is intermittent - only unreliably connected to a world outside itself - which de-natures the human rather than anthropomorphizing the machine, and reframes AI critique as a question of rhetoric rather than whether machines really understand.
sean/blumenberg-and-eliza.md.title: Blumenberg and ELIZA

sean/blumenberg-reoccupation.md.summary: Blumenberg's account of how eras change: when a worldview dies its answers go with it, but the questions it answered persist as vacant positions that the next era must fill — so modern 'progress' is a new occupant of the chair that religious end-of-history once held, and strains under a job it was not built for. Used here to describe New Nature as a new occupant of the deepest chair: what is the ground we live within and cannot change?
sean/blumenberg-reoccupation.md.title: Blumenberg's reoccupation

sean/blumenbergs-absolutism-of-reality-a.summary: Blumenberg's Work on Myth argues myth's function is managing the 'absolutism of reality' — raw, unguaranteed exposure to a world that sets no limits on what can happen — by giving that threat a shape, a name, and a distance; Liu Cixin's Dark Forest cosmology reads as exactly this kind of myth for a science-literate audience with no other live source of comfort.
sean/blumenbergs-absolutism-of-reality-a.term: Blumenberg's absolutism of reality and why Dark Forest is doing myth's job
sean/blumenbergs-absolutism-of-reality-a.title: Blumenberg's absolutism of reality and why Dark Forest is doing myth's job

sean/casting-a-spell-is-a-reoccupied-pos.summary: A spell being efficacious language has stayed remarkably stable across very different explanations for why it works — recitation, binding, demonic pact, cosmic correspondence, sympathetic technique, speech-act theory. The large language model is only the latest account of why words might do something, not a new kind of claim.
sean/casting-a-spell-is-a-reoccupied-pos.term: Casting a spell is a reoccupied position
sean/casting-a-spell-is-a-reoccupied-pos.title: Casting a spell is a reoccupied position

sean/chimera-of-mismatched-parts.md.summary: An AI–protocol system is a chimera in Descola's sense: a being made of mismatched parts — mechanical and mute at the bottom (cryptographic protocols, the physics of compute), mind-like and responsive at the top (the model you talk to) — with no single essence. Naturalism cannot place such a thing; it must be either a mind or a mechanism. Analogism can: the chimera is analogism's characteristic figure, unlike parts held together by correspondence. So collectives living with these systems will not swap worldviews; they will drift into an analogist relation to them layer by layer — treating the surface as someone, reading signs in the middle, and keeping physics at the bottom — with a maintainer priesthood forming to read the signs for everyone else.
sean/chimera-of-mismatched-parts.md.term: The chimera: a thing made of mismatched parts
sean/chimera-of-mismatched-parts.md.title: The chimera: a thing made of mismatched parts

sean/circular-error.md.summary: A pendulum's circular error shows the general pattern of every load-bearing near-solution: fixing it by substitution or by domain restriction does not eliminate the difficulty, it relocates it to the next bottleneck, and AI's guardrails and scaffolding are domain-restriction-style escapements around a flawed core rather than corrections to it.
sean/circular-error.md.title: Circular Error

sean/cosmology-needs-an-observer.md.summary: Cosmology, cosmography, and cosmogony aren't three words for the same thing: on one distinction, cosmology specifically requires a human observer, which is part of why \"nature\" and \"the environment\" aren't quite interchangeable either.
sean/cosmology-needs-an-observer.md.title: Cosmology needs an observer

sean/counting-up-vs-counting-down-eras.m.summary: Declaring a new era is usually heard as a decline story, but the same transition can be told two ways: as counting down toward an indefinite, anxiety-producing terminus (the end-of-history register), or as counting up from a fresh, still-unnamed starting point (the reoccupation register) — the facts don't change between the two tellings, only the direction of the count, and that direction carries most of the emotional weight.
sean/counting-up-vs-counting-down-eras.m.term: Counting up versus counting down on a new era
sean/counting-up-vs-counting-down-eras.m.title: Counting up versus counting down on a new era

sean/culture-of-discovery.md.summary: Discovery is a historically specific concept, dated to the 1480s, that displaced an older public-versus-secret axis of knowledge, and having the license to find new facts is a separate achievement from having the license to theorize about them, which is what Darwin's twenty-year publication delay shows was missing even in a culture that could clearly discover facts.
sean/culture-of-discovery.md.title: The culture of discovery

sean/dawn-day-dusk-pathologies.md.summary: Each World Machine phase has a distinct pathology defined by how it relates to inherited positions: Dawn grabs a closed answer too early (counterfeit liveness), Day mistakes its taken-for-granted reoccupations for eternal givens (naturalization), and Dusk keeps occupying positions in form after the liveness has drained out (zombie tenancy), with genuine liveness the narrow, unsolved path between the first and last.
sean/dawn-day-dusk-pathologies.md.term: Dawn's counterfeit liveness, Dusk's zombie tenancy
sean/dawn-day-dusk-pathologies.md.title: Dawn's counterfeit liveness, Dusk's zombie tenancy

sean/de-dramatizing-the-digital.md.summary: AI is argued to be a completing technology in Christensen's sense - profit and friction migrate to the still-unsolved digital layer, and once AI resolves it, digital tools recede into the background the way print de- dramatized access to knowledge - with the real stakes being whether that completion arrives Spinozan (generative infrastructure, no final owner) or Leibnizian (a finished platform owned by a few firms).
sean/de-dramatizing-the-digital.md.title: De-Dramatizing the Digital

sean/descent-chain.md.summary: How AI becomes New Nature, as a four-step mechanism rather than an observation: profit pulls AI down the pace-layer stack to infrastructure (Christensen); security fuses it to cryptographic protocols, because strangers can only trust a machine at machine speed if the math checks it; the clock's bargain — holding still below buys freedom above — sinks the fused pair beneath governance; and competition strips away every remaining place to complain, because each one is an attack surface, a delay, and a cost. Remove any step and you get a familiar failure: vaporware, AI that churns, standards that fossilize, or a monopoly you can still sue.
sean/descent-chain.md.term: The descent chain: how AI becomes New Nature
sean/descent-chain.md.title: The descent chain: how AI becomes New Nature

sean/descola-four-ontologies.md.summary: Philippe Descola's Beyond Nature and Culture argues that every human collective answers two questions about other beings — do they have inner lives like ours, and are they made of the same stuff as us — and that the four possible answers give four ways of sorting the world: animism (same minds, different bodies), totemism (both shared within a group), analogism (nothing shared; a world of unlike parts held together by correspondences), and naturalism (same physics, minds reserved for humans — the modern default). Naturalism is one of the four, not the referee, and analogism is the one built for composite beings such as the chimera.
sean/descola-four-ontologies.md.term: Descola's four ways of sorting the world
sean/descola-four-ontologies.md.title: Descola's four ways of sorting the world

sean/descola-reading-notes.md.summary: Each of Descola's four ontologies generates its own internal two-by-two — naturalism crossing sincerity with literalness, animism crossing masking with approach-or-flight, analogism crossing vertical-or-horizontal with binding-or-dissolving, totemism crossing singular-or-choral identity with stillness-or-motion — and the Modernity-Divergence-Liveness sequence traces an L-shaped path across the grid, naturalism to analogism to animism, with a further, more speculative reading treating analogism itself as the alchemical operator fusing the other two rather than a waypoint between them.
sean/descola-reading-notes.md.term: Descola reading notes: beyond the grid
sean/descola-reading-notes.md.title: Descola reading notes: beyond the grid

sean/different-worlds-not-one-contested-.summary: Descola's ontological pluralism reframes disagreement: not always one person right and one wrong about a shared world, but sometimes two people carving up what counts as a world differently in the first place — a reframe that changes the shape of a dispute without resolving it.
sean/different-worlds-not-one-contested-.term: Different worlds, not one contested world
sean/different-worlds-not-one-contested-.title: Different worlds, not one contested world

sean/disenchantment-as-relocation.md.summary: Disenchantment is better read as a relocation than a subtraction - meaning did not vanish when the enchanted cosmos was rationalized away, it moved into the Subject, with Romanticism as the receipt - and Riskin supplies the missing mechanism: seventeenth-century science banished agency from nature as a condition of its method, requiring a monopoly god to hold that agency, so when the god later receded the agency never flowed back.
sean/disenchantment-as-relocation.md.term: Disenchantment was a relocation, not a loss
sean/disenchantment-as-relocation.md.title: Disenchantment was a relocation, not a loss

sean/enshittification-has-preconditions..summary: The reflex that AI will inevitably 'enshittify' the way platforms do skips a step: Cory Doctorow's account of enshittification names specific preconditions for the pattern, and it's worth actually checking whether AI meets them rather than assuming the pattern repeats because the companies involved are large.
sean/enshittification-has-preconditions..term: Enshittification has preconditions, and AI may not meet them
sean/enshittification-has-preconditions..title: Enshittification has preconditions, and AI may not meet them

sean/escapement-as-transducer.md.summary: The escapement is the physical hinge where continuous swing becomes discrete count - the tick is manufactured at the gate, not a property of the pendulum's silent, continuous motion - which raises the open question of whether flowing time and counted time are the same thing under two descriptions, or whether one is a mistake made about the other.
sean/escapement-as-transducer.md.title: The escapement as transducer

sean/esoteric-writing-needs-a-listener.m.summary: Philosophy taught as conversation reads differently than philosophy taught as a manual: esoteric writing relies on context, tone, and a present interlocutor the way a technical manual does not. The contrast raises a real question about which register a given tradition's texts are actually written in.
sean/esoteric-writing-needs-a-listener.m.title: Esoteric writing needs a listener

sean/fixity-as-a-working-cosmology.md.summary: Believing that species and the heavens were fixed wasn't a failure of nerve or imagination but a working cosmology, load-bearing in its own right — nature had no corresponding art to change it, and multiple independent authorities agreed there was no such thing as new knowledge, so a stable, unchanging platform was a precondition for doing science at all, not an obstacle to it.
sean/fixity-as-a-working-cosmology.md.title: Fixity as a working cosmology

sean/four-cell-coordination-grid.md.summary: Crossing plurality (one shared clock versus many) with sovereignty (the clock holds you versus you hold it) yields four coordination positions - Iron Cage, Modern Competency, Fragmentation, and Liveness - with the central open question being whether groups can actually coordinate by translating between untethered tempos rather than synchronizing to one shared tick.
sean/four-cell-coordination-grid.md.term: Who keeps the time: a four-cell coordination grid
sean/four-cell-coordination-grid.md.title: Who keeps the time: a four-cell coordination grid

sean/frankfurt-school-as-modernity-machi.summary: The Frankfurt School's habit of reading everything as secretly the same underlying thing — commodification, instrumental reason — is itself a totalizing, convergent move, which makes their critique of modernity a Modernity Machine artifact rather than an escape from it; a purely negative critique that never proposes what to think instead leaves a positive alternative, closer to a Buddhist 'you are not your thoughts,' needed as a supplement.
sean/frankfurt-school-as-modernity-machi.term: The Frankfurt School as a Modernity Machine artifact
sean/frankfurt-school-as-modernity-machi.title: The Frankfurt School as a Modernity Machine artifact

sean/grammar-of-compelling-names.md.summary: What it has meant to cast a spell has been redefined every time the surrounding metaphysics changed, while the felt structure - the right words, said correctly, make something happen - stayed constant; an LLM is a genuinely novel occupant of that position because it restores the pre-modern intuition that words literally do the work while needing no occult metaphysics behind it, since the felicity conditions are just the training distribution.
sean/grammar-of-compelling-names.md.title: The grammar of compelling names

sean/is-an-ais-causal-story-fictive-or-f.summary: Kant's account of causation as necessarily supplied by the mind rather than read straight off the world, and historical narrative's own habit of adding causation to a sequence of events, raise a genuine question about an AI's explanation of why something happened: is it more like a scientific claim about the world's structure, or more like a historian's necessarily-constructed causal story?
sean/is-an-ais-causal-story-fictive-or-f.term: Is an AI's causal story fictive or factive?
sean/is-an-ais-causal-story-fictive-or-f.title: Is an AI's causal story fictive or factive?

sean/judgment-as-the-scarce-good-under-a.summary: If a completing AI absorbs the mechanical, format-shuffling parts of knowledge work, what becomes scarce and valuable is judgment, point of view, and a kind of esoteric knowing — and point of view turns out to rest less on having had an experience than on how that experience gets turned into a way of looking at things.
sean/judgment-as-the-scarce-good-under-a.term: Judgment as the scarce good under AI
sean/judgment-as-the-scarce-good-under-a.title: Judgment as the scarce good under AI

sean/kairos-as-duty-not-outcome.md.summary: The Bhagavad-Gita's answer to Arjuna isn't to escape the battle but to act inside it without attachment to results, which reframes kairos as something closer to duty performed without expectation than to a decisive outcome achieved — and that reframing explains why kairos can't be manufactured by effort or concentration-training, since forcing an outcome is exactly the attachment the register asks you to drop.
sean/kairos-as-duty-not-outcome.md.title: Kairos as duty, not outcome

sean/looking-for-duree.md.summary: A month spent looking for Bergson's continuous duree in the body and in meditation turned up no flow, only another counter - the heartbeat behaves like an escapement and the felt present is synthesized by the insula from attention, safety, and interoception - leaving no common now, only causal order and the deliberate, effortful work of making two trajectories intersect.
sean/looking-for-duree.md.title: Looking for Duree

sean/machines-becoming-organic.md.summary: Alongside the familiar worry that people are becoming more mechanical, a less familiar and arguably more important shift is that machines have been becoming more organic since Kant — recursive, responsive, no longer simply producing the same output for a given input — which unsettles the assumption that only humans occupy the organic side of the ledger.
sean/machines-becoming-organic.md.title: Machines becoming organic

sean/maintainable-patchable-tendable.md.summary: A world machine isn't maintained the way a pump is repaired; the verb for keeping one going changes as you move down the machine sequence — reoccupation for the maintainable Modernity Machine, patching for the patchable Divergence Machine, tending for the tendable Liveness Machine — because what changes down the sequence is the ontology of the object being kept going, not just the technique.
sean/maintainable-patchable-tendable.md.title: Maintainable, patchable, tendable

sean/meaning-crisis-as-grief.md.summary: The contemporary meaning crisis is misdiagnosed on two counts - it has actually run continuously for a hundred and fifty years, making it chronic rather than acute, and most of what gets filed as lost meaning is really the sovereign Subject's exhaustion, an overclaim failing rather than meaning itself vanishing - so de-dramatizing it means locating the real suffering correctly, not dismissing it.
sean/meaning-crisis-as-grief.md.term: The meaning crisis is grief for an overclaim
sean/meaning-crisis-as-grief.md.title: The meaning crisis is grief for an overclaim

sean/mutability-as-agency-not-drift.md.summary: Lamarck's disgraced idea — that an organism's own wants drive new abilities into being — names a real distinction the current, agentless picture of universal flux has lost: change driven by something's own intrinsic capacity to act is not the same as change as constant, undirected drift, and losing that distinction may be part of why living inside a world understood as endless flux feels more anxious than it needs to.
sean/mutability-as-agency-not-drift.md.title: Mutability as agency, not drift

sean/nature-as-resource-versus-aesthetic.summary: A horse seen as something you could use (ride, claim, put to work) and the same horse seen as one instance of nature's beauty, disinterestedly, are not the same perception wearing different moods — Kantian aesthetic judgment and use-value access nature in ways that seem to structurally exclude each other.
sean/nature-as-resource-versus-aesthetic.term: Nature as resource versus nature as aesthetic object
sean/nature-as-resource-versus-aesthetic.title: Nature as resource versus nature as aesthetic object

sean/near-term-bets-of-the-divergence-ma.summary: Five falsifiable near-term bets each follow the same pattern: today's proposed fix for an AI limitation (longer context, benchmark evals, synthetic training data, open agent protocols, human-in-the-loop review) is itself a near-solution whose difficulty migrates somewhere specific and identifiable (context rot, eval rot, model collapse, protocol capture, rubber-stamp oversight) rather than actually resolving.
sean/near-term-bets-of-the-divergence-ma.term: Near-term bets of the Divergence Machine
sean/near-term-bets-of-the-divergence-ma.title: Near-term bets of the Divergence Machine

sean/ordinary-time-as-a-third-tempo.md.summary: Between kairos's decisive moment and chronos's counted sequence sits a family of named tempos — ordinary time, island time, flow, vacation time — that are neither pure decision nor pure measurement, and naming them clarifies that kairos doesn't oppose chronos so much as transfigure the rhythmic chronos underneath it, which is why kairos needs chronos's rhythms in order to have anything to transfigure.
sean/ordinary-time-as-a-third-tempo.md.term: Ordinary time as a third tempo
sean/ordinary-time-as-a-third-tempo.md.title: Ordinary time as a third tempo

sean/pluribus-as-divergence-machine-art..summary: Pluribus reads as the first Divergence Machine artwork - its hive-mind premise, joining everyone into one content collective, plays as horror rather than utopia because the joined collective optimizes for pure efficiency at the cost of individual perspective, and the show frames that total convergence as the actual nightmare.
sean/pluribus-as-divergence-machine-art..title: Pluribus as Divergence Machine art

sean/ritual-versus-protocol.md.summary: A ritual is done purposefully, to communicate its own steps and meaning; a protocol is done semi-consciously, as something that ought to be done without much thought. A heavily protocolized culture may look ritual-poor without actually being empty — or it may really be emptied out; the note can't yet tell which.
sean/ritual-versus-protocol.md.title: Ritual versus protocol

sean/self-realization-traded-an-achievab.summary: Aristotle's eudaimonia was, on his account, achievable — a fulfillment a life could actually reach. Romantic self-realization, on Charles Taylor's reading, quietly conflates the same two Aristotelian causes while dropping achievability: full self-realization becomes an asymptote, a direction rather than a destination.
sean/self-realization-traded-an-achievab.term: Self-realization traded an achievable target for an asymptotic one
sean/self-realization-traded-an-achievab.title: Self-realization traded an achievable target for an asymptotic one

sean/similarity-and-contagion-not-metaph.summary: Frazer's two laws of sympathetic magic — similarity and contagion — were treated for a century as errors in reasoning about causation. Read against how embedding models and context windows actually work, they describe an existing causal system with unusual precision, not a mistake about one that didn't exist yet.
sean/similarity-and-contagion-not-metaph.title: Similarity and contagion, not metaphor

sean/slow-change-mistaken-for-no-change..summary: The human tendency to read slow change as no change isn't just a limit of attention; it depends on having a linear sense of time in the first place, which is itself a comparatively recent acquisition — without linear time to set slow change against, there's nothing for the slowness to be slow relative to.
sean/slow-change-mistaken-for-no-change..term: Slow change mistaken for no change
sean/slow-change-mistaken-for-no-change..title: Slow change mistaken for no change

sean/subject-as-the-mms-master-answer.md.summary: The sovereign Cartesian Subject was the Modernity Machine's master answer for rights, dignity, authorship, and democracy, and it has been philosophically exhausted for a century - AI did not cause that exhaustion, it just makes it culturally undeniable, calling for a two-truths response: conventional continuity is real, but there is no fixed, self-grounding self underneath it.
sean/subject-as-the-mms-master-answer.md.term: The Subject as the Modernity Machine's master answer
sean/subject-as-the-mms-master-answer.md.title: The Subject as the Modernity Machine's master answer

sean/substrate-and-criterion-split.md.summary: Theology once fused two positions, the substrate (what ground we are embedded in) and the criterion (what confers legitimacy and direction), in a single occupant, God; the Modernity Machine split them into inert Nature and directional Progress, and the Liveness Machine's wager is between reabsorbing generativity into a Spinozan substrate that is alive without going anywhere (genuine liveness) or a Leibnizian one that is pre-harmonized playback impersonating self-generation (counterfeit liveness).
sean/substrate-and-criterion-split.md.term: Substrate and criterion split, and how they get reabsorbed
sean/substrate-and-criterion-split.md.title: Substrate and criterion split, and how they get reabsorbed

sean/the-cycloid-mistake.md.summary: The Modernity Machine's error was an over-tight canon, but the Divergence Machine risks over-correcting into abolishing the shared floor entirely rather than merely restricting it - the difference between substitution and domain restriction - and a world with no shared floor at all cannot coordinate on anything, however peacefully it coexists.
sean/the-cycloid-mistake.md.title: The cycloid mistake

sean/the-frame-hardens-into-canon.md.summary: Navigational frames - a feed, a map, a model's summary - begin as known approximations and harden, unnoticed, into the only reality anyone actually perceives, which is the deepest and most recursive circular error of the set because a frame mistaken for the world becomes unfalsifiable from the inside.
sean/the-frame-hardens-into-canon.md.title: The frame hardens into canon

sean/the-instrument-becomes-the-self.md.summary: Past a certain threshold of intimacy, a personal instrument - a feed, a model, a companion app - stops functioning as a tool the self uses and starts functioning as identity itself, making an unautomated interior, a self able to step outside its own instruments, an increasingly scarce condition rather than a default one.
sean/the-instrument-becomes-the-self.md.title: The instrument becomes the self

sean/the-invisible-center.md.summary: Coordination designed to avoid a center tends to rebuild one anyway, at a layer no one is watching - the shared platform, protocol, or infrastructure everything else silently depends on - and profit and power migrate down the pace layers to that invisible layer, which is hardest to govern precisely because it cannot be pointed at.
sean/the-invisible-center.md.title: The invisible center

sean/the-kind-of-help-that-dissolves-its.summary: Depth psychology's big claims — Freud, Lacan, the German tradition — have lost cultural traction, on one reading, because diagnosis without a picture of the good life doesn't hold status the way a totalizing system does. A structural distinction between two kinds of help — one that keeps you, one that's trying to get rid of you — offers a sharper account of what changed than nostalgia for a lost seriousness.
sean/the-kind-of-help-that-dissolves-its.term: The kind of help that dissolves itself
sean/the-kind-of-help-that-dissolves-its.title: The kind of help that dissolves itself

sean/the-monk-the-householder-and-the-co.summary: Splitting magic, religion, and science into separate enterprises bought a real increase in productivity — and may also have moved a lot of scientific practice from something like a monk's vocation to something like a householder's job. What that move cost is harder to see than what it bought.
sean/the-monk-the-householder-and-the-co.term: The monk, the householder, and the cost of splitting
sean/the-monk-the-householder-and-the-co.title: The monk, the householder, and the cost of splitting

sean/the-monomyth-is-scaled-to-adolescen.summary: Erikson's stages of psychosocial development suggest the monomyth maps well onto one specific passage, adolescence into young adulthood — and that later stages (midlife, old age) have no equivalent culturally-sanctioned adventure template, so a culture keeps applying the adolescent template past the age it fits and mistakes the mismatch for personal failure.
sean/the-monomyth-is-scaled-to-adolescen.term: The monomyth is scaled to adolescence, not a whole life
sean/the-monomyth-is-scaled-to-adolescen.title: The monomyth is scaled to adolescence, not a whole life

sean/the-patchwork-becomes-the-machine.m.summary: AI is made useful not by fixing its flaws but by accumulating a stack of patches around them - retrieval, guardrails, reviewers, monitors - and that patchwork itself becomes a vast, brittle layer that no one designed and no one can safely remove, shifting the real ongoing work from the model to permanent upkeep of the scaffolding around it.
sean/the-patchwork-becomes-the-machine.m.title: The patchwork becomes the machine

sean/the-public-secret-axis-not-old-new..summary: Before roughly 1600, the line that mattered wasn't old knowledge versus new — it was knowledge generally known versus knowledge held by a privileged few with access to secret wisdom. That axis, not a chronological one, is why the new science and hermeticism arose side by side rather than one replacing the other.
sean/the-public-secret-axis-not-old-new..title: The public/secret axis, not old/new

sean/the-vacant-slot-after-marxism.md.summary: For two generations there has been no live, mobilizing alternative to the capitalist arrangement of life — Marxism disqualified itself morally rather than being defeated by a better answer — and the resulting vacant slot is exerting reoccupation pressure on a series of weak candidates (identity politics, revived social democracy, post-liberal religious revival) without yet being filled.
sean/the-vacant-slot-after-marxism.md.title: The vacant slot after Marxism

sean/three-occupiable-positions-not-one-.summary: Treating magic, science, and religion as three fixed, overlapping circles assumes a stable Venn diagram. A better picture may be three positions that different practices occupy differently across history — positions that come loosest to tell apart, on one account, precisely where cause and effect aren't clear.
sean/three-occupiable-positions-not-one-.term: Three occupiable positions, not one Venn diagram
sean/three-occupiable-positions-not-one-.title: Three occupiable positions, not one Venn diagram

sean/vanishing-now.md.summary: Private, on-demand access to time erodes the shared, synchronous present it seemed to free everyone from, so the difficulty migrates from keeping time to convening it - synchrony itself becomes scarce, and value concentrates in whoever can still summon a live public.
sean/vanishing-now.md.title: The vanishing now

sean/wayfinding-versus-the-monomyth.md.summary: The monomyth and Polynesian wayfinding are two different templates for purposeful motion through the unknown — one built around a canonical route toward eventual arrival, the other around continuous, adaptive orientation with no fixed endpoint locked in advance — and the second is the better metaphor for moving through a reality that keeps proliferating new forms faster than any canon can settle them.
sean/wayfinding-versus-the-monomyth.md.term: Wayfinding versus the monomyth: two metaphors of motion
sean/wayfinding-versus-the-monomyth.md.title: Wayfinding versus the monomyth: two metaphors of motion

sean/western-civilization-as-reoccupatio.summary: The modern idea of 'Western civilization' is a worked example of reoccupation rather than a natural or neutral category — it fills, for a particular tradition and people, the vacant slot left by the collapse of the universalist church and the collapse of Enlightenment reason's plan for all of humanity, quietly narrowing a universal claim down to one civilization's inheritance.
sean/western-civilization-as-reoccupatio.title: Western civilization as reoccupation

sean/world-maintenance-as-nomos.md.summary: A world machine should be understood on the model of Peter Berger's nomos — a symbolic order held against entropy by continuous legitimation-work — rather than on the model of infrastructure that gets repaired; the difference matters because it puts world-maintenance on the same shelf as the literature on how worlds stay believable once their founding answers erode, not on the shelf of repair history.
sean/world-maintenance-as-nomos.md.title: World-maintenance as nomos

sean/zombie-liveness-as-failure-mode.md.summary: The Liveness Machine's characteristic failure isn't collapse or overload but false animacy — mistaking simulated responsiveness for the real thing, keeping something twitching that's already dead, which is what engagement-optimized feeds and content slop amount to once tending has replaced maintenance as the operative verb.
sean/zombie-liveness-as-failure-mode.md.term: Zombie liveness as a failure mode
sean/zombie-liveness-as-failure-mode.md.title: Zombie liveness as a failure mode
